en:
## New Features

- Merging and forking no longer require a commit: chapter workspaces are now combined through the snapshot DAG, so a chapter with uncommitted work can be merged as it stands and your git history is never written to on NarraFork's behalf
- Forking without a named fork point now carries the parent's uncommitted changes into the new chapter instead of starting from its last commit
- Undoing a commit-free merge keeps whatever the target did after the merge, and hands the source chapter back its uncommitted work rather than just its last commit
- The merge conflict preview is now computed through the same path the merge itself takes, so it can no longer promise a clean merge and then conflict
- Editing a message and regenerating now offers a real choice about your files, sharing the same confirmation dialog (with scope selection and the exact file list) as rollback-to-block
- Narrator message list: system injections render as individually collapsible mini-cards, and truncated bodies are fetched as you read instead of costing a hint line each

## Improvements

- Copying text from the message list now rebuilds it from the list's own structure, so soft wraps, caret fillers and KaTeX spans no longer corrupt the copied result
- Waking a chapter restores uncommitted work that was left behind when its pre-dormant auto-save failed
- A merge interrupted by a server restart now restores the target worktree instead of leaving it full of conflict markers
- `find` with `-exec` is no longer reported as high risk when the command it runs only reads

## Removals

- Multi-party chat groups have been removed, along with @mention group conversations and narrator proxy-approval of permissions. Named narrators themselves are unchanged

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a frozen tab when a streaming message jumped rather than grew (a reconnect, a retry, or switching narrators mid-stream)
- Fixed tables containing `$` amounts being swallowed: inline math no longer spans a line break
- Fixed the message column staying pinned at the wrong width after repeatedly toggling a dock panel
- Fixed an editor's newly attached files being deleted by the rollback the same edit performed
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 合并与分叉不再需要先提交：章节工作区改为通过快照 DAG 结合，带未提交改动的章节可以按当前状态直接合并，NarraFork 不会再为了自己记账去写你的 git 历史
- 不指定分叉点时，分叉会带上父章节的未提交改动，而不是从它的最后一次提交开始
- 撤销无提交合并时会保留目标章节在合并之后做的工作，并把源章节的未提交内容还给它，而不是只剩最后一次提交
- 合并冲突预检改为走真实合并路径，不会再先承诺「可以干净合并」然后冲突
- 编辑消息并重新生成时，对文件的处理成为真正可选项，并与按块回退共用同一个确认弹窗（含范围选择和确切的文件清单）
- 叙述者消息列表：系统注入记录改为每条一张可独立折叠的小卡；截断的正文改为随阅读自动取回，不再为每张卡预留一行提示

## 改进

- 从消息列表复制文本改为按列表自身结构重建，软换行、光标填充和 KaTeX 元素不会再让复制结果出错
- 唤醒章节时会恢复因休眠前自动保存失败而遗留的未提交内容
- 服务器重启中断的合并会自动还原目标工作区，不再留下满是冲突标记的目录
- `find` 搭配 `-exec` 执行只读命令时不再被判为高风险

## 移除

- 移除多方群聊，包括 @mention 群聊会话与叙述者代审权限。命名叙述者本身保持不变

## 修复

- 修复流式消息发生跳变（重连、重试或流式过程中切换叙述者）时标签页卡死
- 修复含 `$` 金额的表格被吞：行内数学公式不再跨行匹配
- 修复反复开合面板后消息列宽被永久钉在错误宽度
- 修复编辑消息时新添加的附件被同一次编辑的文件回退删除
